method: Receipt-anchored work and effective per-sequence rates fitted using D generation counters during windows of stable observed streaming occupancy. Link queues charge serialization and KVs wait for the slowest rank. Same receive worker serializes, and within-session dependencies retime its next transfer. An exact native round trip is by construction. CPU scenario estimates; D widths use streaming occupancy as a proxy. P service, original slot/page admission delays, routes, failure pattern, EOS and Store are anchored, with no PFC/firmware model.
